title.zh: 恒指周一收涨118点至23,211点,科技股跌幅收窄,投资者静待本周央行利率决定
title.en: Hang Seng closes up 118 points at 23,211 on Monday as tech losses narrow and investors await this week's rate decisions

analysis.zh: 港股周一收市,恒生指数上涨118点或0.5%,报23,211点,成交额1,758亿港元。恒生科技指数则下跌0.4%至3,857点,不过跌幅比之前收窄;上证综指升0.2%至3,697点,深证成指跌1.2%至11,534点。市场把焦点放在本周的央行利率决定上。就像考试前一天,大家不急着下注,先看看考题再说。
analysis.en: Hong Kong stocks rose on Monday, with the Hang Seng Index up 118 points, or 0.5%, at 23,211 on turnover of HK$175.8 billion. The Hang Seng Tech Index slipped 0.4% to 3,857, though its losses narrowed; the Shanghai Composite gained 0.2% to 3,697 and the Shenzhen Component fell 1.2% to 11,534. Investors are watching central bank interest rate decisions later this week. It is a bit like the day before an exam: people hold back from big bets until they see the questions.

dda.zh: 指数在科技股拖累和央行消息之间小幅摆动时,定期定额的好处是不必猜测短期方向。每月固定投入,长期有助平均成本,也让你少受每天新闻的影响。
dda.en: With the index swinging modestly between a tech drag and central bank news, the benefit of regular (DDA) investing is that you needn't guess short-term direction. A fixed monthly amount may help smooth your average cost over time and keeps daily headlines from driving decisions.

prs.zh: 退休规划看的是几十年的累积,一天的港股涨跌影响有限。可以趁机检视PRS基金的区域分布是否过度集中;每年供款最高RM3,000可享个人税务减免。
prs.en: Retirement planning is built over decades, so one day's Hong Kong move matters little. It's a good moment to check whether your PRS fund's regional mix is too concentrated; contributions of up to RM3,000 a year also qualify for personal tax relief.

lump.zh: 中港股市行情容易受政策与科技情绪牵动。单笔资金可考虑分阶段投入以分散时间点风险,并确认单一地区或板块占比,是否符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: China and Hong Kong markets can swing on policy and tech sentiment. A lump sum can be phased in to spread timing risk, and it's worth checking whether any single region or sector is too large for your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 港股涨跌对大马债券基金的直接影响不大,但本周多家央行公布利率决定,全球利率预期可能影响马来西亚政府债券(MGS)与伊斯兰债券的收益率。债券基金通常在股市波动时起到平衡组合的作用。
bond.en: Hong Kong's moves have little direct effect on Malaysian bond funds, but with several central banks deciding on rates this week, global rate expectations may influence MGS and sukuk yields. Bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer when equities fluctuate.

title.zh: 美股期货小幅走高,Alphabet、微软、亚马逊本周财报,美联储周二开会
title.en: US futures edge up as Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon report this week and the Fed meets Tuesday

analysis.zh: 周日晚间道指期货升约0.22%,标普500期货升约0.11%,纳指100期货基本持平。上周五道指跌1.23%至52,215.16点,标普500跌0.52%至7,623.68点,标普已连续两周下跌;科技与AI股因对AI可持续性和债务的忧虑而走弱。布伦特原油约114.85美元,较高位回落;10年期美国国债收益率跌至4.966%。本周Alphabet、微软、亚马逊、Visa、波音等公布财报,美联储周二开始会议,市场普遍预期利率不变。这周像是大考周:财报和央行同时放榜。
analysis.en: Late Sunday, Dow futures were up about 0.22% and S&P 500 futures about 0.11%, while Nasdaq-100 futures were roughly flat. On Friday the Dow fell 1.23% to 52,215.16 and the S&P 500 lost 0.52% to 7,623.68, its second straight weekly decline, as tech and AI stocks weakened on worries about AI sustainability and debt. Brent was about US$114.85, off its highs, and the 10-year Treasury yield eased to 4.966%. Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, Visa and Boeing report this week, and the Fed begins its meeting Tuesday with markets largely expecting rates to hold. It is something like exam week: earnings and the central bank both post results at once.

dda.zh: 财报周往往让市场情绪起伏加大。定期定额的纪律在于不必挑选入市日子,持续投入并定期检视,通常比根据单周消息调整更贴合长期目标。
dda.en: Earnings weeks often amplify sentiment swings. The discipline of regular (DDA) investing is that you don't have to pick a day to enter; staying invested and reviewing periodically generally suits long-term goals better than reacting to one week's news.

prs.zh: 全球科技巨头占许多全球基金的比重不小,财报周的波动可能间接影响退休基金表现。长期目标不必因此改变,但可检视PRS的资产分布;每年最高RM3,000的供款可享税务减免。
prs.en: Large tech names make up a notable share of many global funds, so earnings-week swings may indirectly touch retirement fund performance. Long-term goals needn't change because of it, but it's a good time to review your PRS asset mix; contributions of up to RM3,000 a year qualify for tax relief.

lump.zh: 科技股集中度高时,单笔投资要留意是否过度押注少数公司。分阶段投入可分散时间点风险,同时确认配置符合目标和风险承受度。
lump.en: When tech concentration is high, a lump sum calls for a check on reliance on a handful of companies. Phasing in can spread timing risk, and it's worth confirming the mix matches your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 美联储会议和美国国债收益率(10年期约4.97%)是全球债券的重要参考。结果可能影响马来西亚政府债券与伊斯兰债券的收益率及令吉走势,国家银行的OPR也受通胀与利率环境影响。债券基金通常在股市波动时起平衡作用。
bond.en: The Fed meeting and US Treasury yields (the 10-year near 4.97%) are key global reference points. The outcome may influence MGS and sukuk yields and the ringgit, and Bank Negara's OPR also depends on the inflation and rate backdrop. Bond funds generally help balance a portfolio when equities fluctuate.

title.zh: 消息:IDG领先竞购ASMPT表面贴装业务,估值或逾10亿美元
title.en: IDG reported to lead the race for ASMPT's SMT unit, valued at over US$1 billion

analysis.zh: 据三位知情人士,IDG资本是竞购ASMPT(0522)表面贴装(SMT)业务中进展最快的一方,该业务估值可能超过10亿美元;ASMPT期望约15亿美元,买家出价可能低于此数。该业务服务AI服务器、光收发器和电动车,2026年上半年收入增53.1%至38.7亿港元,订单增87.8%创同期新高。交易可能在数周内达成,但条款尚未最终确定。AI热潮就像淘金热,卖铲子的公司也变得炙手可热。
analysis.en: According to three sources, IDG Capital is the most advanced bidder for ASMPT's (0522) surface mount technology (SMT) unit, which could be valued at over US$1 billion; ASMPT is seeking US$1.5 billion and buyers may fall short. The unit serves AI servers, optical transceivers and EVs, with first-half 2026 revenue up 53.1% to HK$3.87 billion and bookings up 87.8% to a record HK$6.98 billion for the period. A deal could come in the coming weeks, though terms aren't final. The AI boom is a bit like a gold rush, where the companies selling the shovels become sought-after too.

dda.zh: 这类并购消息提醒我们,AI供应链很长。通过分散的信托基金定期投资,可以间接参与产业链,而不必押注单一公司;定期定额也避免追逐消息。
dda.en: Deal news like this shows how long the AI supply chain is. Investing regularly through diversified unit trusts can give indirect exposure across the chain without betting on any single company, and DDA helps avoid chasing headlines.

prs.zh: 这只是未最终确定的传闻,不应影响退休规划。重点是长期、分散;可检视PRS基金是否对科技板块过度集中,并善用每年最高RM3,000的税务减免。
prs.en: This is an unconfirmed report and shouldn't change retirement planning. The focus remains long-term and diversified; consider whether your PRS fund is too concentrated in tech, and make use of the up to RM3,000 yearly tax relief.

lump.zh: 单一并购消息不是投资依据。单笔资金宜先看整体配置是否过度集中于热门主题,并可分阶段投入以分散时间点风险,同时对照自己的目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: A single deal report is not an investment basis. For a lump sum, first check whether the overall mix is overly concentrated in popular themes; phasing in can spread timing risk, and everything should match your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 这则新闻对大马债券基金几乎没有直接影响。债券基金的角色更多是在股市主题热门而波动较大时,为组合提供相对稳定的收益来源,并受OPR、通胀与令吉影响。
bond.en: This story has little direct effect on Malaysian bond funds. Their role is more to provide a relatively steadier income source when equity themes run hot and volatile, influenced by the OPR, inflation and the ringgit.
